content: Ishaan Bose contacted insurance agent Ramesh Tiwari to ask about paying the $25 policy reinstatement fee. Ramesh provided a secure payment link and confirmed that credit cards, debit cards, net-banking, and PayPal are accepted. Ramesh also informed Ishaan that the completed form and payment receipt must be submitted by 30/09/2026 to ensure retroactive coverage.

action_items: Customer to complete and return the signed form and payment receipt by 30/09/2026
Customer to pay the $25 reinstatement fee via the provided link
